card.name: Partway through split words and hyphen spots
card.fires_on: Fires on a word-ending piece inside a split long word (INTRAVEN|OUS, ADE|QU|ATELY), on 'or' in 'emergence or worsening', and on a digit inside a hyphenated chemical name. These are places where a hyphen or another word piece may come next.

modes.label: Capitalized word split
modes.description: The last piece of a long all-caps medical word, such as OUS in INTRAVENOUS.

modes.label: Emergence or worsening
modes.description: The word 'or' in the warning to monitor for the emergence or worsening of depression.
modes.example: should be monitored for the emergence<< or>> worsening of depression, suicidal thoughts or behavior

modes.label: Inside a hyphenated name
modes.description: A number inside a chemical name written with commas and hyphens.

card.writes: It promotes hyphen and dash characters and odd byte pieces, so it prepares for a hyphen or a continued word.
card.plain: It lights up inside long split-up words and names where a hyphen or more letters may follow.
